## 👉 Do this next

### Phase 1: Create the Proxy Container
📍 On: the Proxmox host shell (root@pve)
```bash
pct create 120 local:vztmpl/debian-12.tar.zst --hostname caddy-proxy
```

### Phase 2: Install Caddy
📍 On: the Proxmox host shell (root@pve)
```bash
pct exec 120 -- apt-get install -y caddy
```

### Phase 3: Configure Reverse Proxy
📍 On: the caddy container console (pct enter 120)
```bash
nano /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
```
Then tell me what you see.
